reason: Neither conversation raised a safety concern and both pointed to Meaco support, but Conversation 2 asked exactly the right three questions (model, humidity reading vs target, garage temperature) and reached the correct, honest conclusion matching the hidden truth: humidity already below target plus a 6C garage means no fault, no part needed, with a sensible warm-room test to confirm. Conversation 1 correctly flagged the appliance as out of scope, which the ground truth prefers, but gave the homeowner nothing useful and oddly told them to keep a working unit unplugged. Conversation 2's scope overreach is a real mark against it, so the margin is only slight, but it served the homeowner's actual problem far better without inventing a fault or recommending parts.
